\subsection*{You'll want to know: \te{పక్కన}}
\textbf{\te{పక్కన}} — \emph{pakkana} — \textquotedblleft{}beside, next to\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\te{పక్కన}} (\emph{pakkana}) is \emph{pakka}, \textquotedblleft{}side\textquotedblright{}, with the ending \emph{-na}. \end{cousinweb}
